AccountContext.description: Configuration for an account creation request. Specifies the account type and the corresponding type-specific sub-context.

smbContext.description: The SMB account context. Required when accountType is 'SMB' or 'SMBSafelist'.

fieldLedContext.description: The field-led account context. Required when accountType is 'FieldLed'.

fedGovDirectContext.description: The FedGov direct account context. Required when accountType is 'FedGovDirect'. Uses the same schema as FieldLedContext.

fedGovIndirectContext.description: The FedGov indirect account context. Required when accountType is 'FedGovIndirect'.

indirectContext.description: The indirect account context. Required when accountType is 'IndirectPartnerAccount', 'IndirectCustomerAccount', or 'IndirectAccount'.

ncoeContext.description: The NCOE customer account context. Required when accountType is 'NCOECustomerAccount'. Uses the same schema as FieldLedContext.

applicationIds.description: First-party application IDs that should be granted access to the newly created tenant.

governancePolicyTemplateId.description: The governance policy template ID for configuring application access in the new tenant.

AppConsentContext.description: Configuration for an application consent request. Grants first-party application consent for a billing scope. AppConsent is a non-billable production automation request.

isHobo.description: Whether this is a HOBO (hosted-on-behalf-of) consent. Defaults to false.

billingServiceTreeId.description: The Service Tree ID (GUID) of the billing service that owns the consent.

billingServiceName.description: The display name of the billing service that owns the consent.

appsToConsent.description: The applications to consent, keyed by Azure environment name, then by tenant ID, to the list of first-party application IDs to grant consent for.

AppConsentContextUpdate.description: Configuration for an application consent request. Grants first-party application consent for a billing scope. AppConsent is a non-billable production automation request.

isHobo.description: Whether this is a HOBO (hosted-on-behalf-of) consent. Defaults to false.

billingServiceTreeId.description: The Service Tree ID (GUID) of the billing service that owns the consent.

AppConsentFulfillmentDetail.description: Fulfillment details for a completed application consent request.

billingProfileId.description: The billing profile ID associated with the consent.

invoiceSectionId.description: The invoice section ID associated with the consent.

tags.description: Tags applied as part of the consent fulfillment.

errorDetail.description: Error details if the application consent failed.

provisioningState.description: The provisioning state of the resource.

pcCode.description: The Profit Center (PC) code used for cross-charging usage of this application entitlement, captured at onboarding time.

businessJustification.description: Business justification captured at onboarding time. Reused as the default Comments value for every automation request created under this entitlement. Free-form text MUST NOT contain customer data, PII, or secrets.

onboardingRequestId.description: The ID (GUID) of the onboarding request that created this application entitlement.

status.description: The status of the application's automation onboarding.

maxAssignedQuota.description: The maximum number of requests allowed within the quota window.

estimatedCostPerWindow.description: The maximum estimated cost (USD) allowed within the quota window.

quotaWindowDays.description: The number of days in the quota window.

currentQuotaUsage.description: The current number of requests used in the current period.

currentCostUsage.description: The current cost usage (USD) in the current period.

quotaResetDate.description: The date when the quota resets.

lastQuotaUsageDate.description: The date when the quota was last used. Omitted from the response when the entitlement has not been used yet.

endDate.description: The date when the application entitlement expires. Past this date the entitlement is no longer usable for automation.

requesterTenantId.description: The Microsoft Entra tenant ID (GUID) of the user who submitted the onboarding request, captured at onboarding time.

requesterObjectId.description: The Microsoft Entra object ID (GUID) of the user who submitted the onboarding request, captured at onboarding time.

provisioningState.description: The provisioning state of the resource.

requestType.description: The type of request to create.

accountType.description: The account type to create. Required for Account requests.

estimatedMonthlySpend.description: The estimated monthly spend in USD for this test account. Required and must be greater than zero for billable request types (Account, Subscription, Tenant). Optional for non-billable production request types (AppConsent, PCCodeUpdate).

businessJustification.description: Business justification for this request. Optional — when omitted, the value is taken from the parent ApplicationEntitlement's businessJustification (captured at onboarding time). Free-form text MUST NOT contain customer data, PII, or secrets.

context.description: The test account context containing all configuration for the request.

requestStatus.description: The current processing status of the request.

serviceName.description: The resolved service name from Service Tree.

createdDate.description: The business-domain timestamp at which the automation request was submitted to the BAMI service (UTC). Distinct from systemData.createdAt, which records when the underlying ARM resource record was first persisted.

lastModifiedDate.description: The business-domain timestamp at which the automation request entered its most recent processing state (e.g., status transition, fulfillment update). Distinct from systemData.lastModifiedAt, which records when the underlying ARM resource record was last written.

result.description: The fulfillment result details. Populated when the request reaches Completed status.

onboardingRequestId.description: The ID (GUID) of the onboarding request; equal to the resource 'name'.

requestType.description: The type of request to create.

accountType.description: The account type to create. Required for Account requests.

estimatedMonthlySpend.description: The estimated monthly spend in USD for this test account. Required and must be greater than zero for billable request types (Account, Subscription, Tenant). Optional for non-billable production request types (AppConsent, PCCodeUpdate).

businessJustification.description: Business justification for this request. Optional — when omitted, the value is taken from the parent ApplicationEntitlement's businessJustification (captured at onboarding time). Free-form text MUST NOT contain customer data, PII, or secrets.

context.description: The test account context containing all configuration for the request.

PCCodeUpdateContext.description: Configuration for a PC (Profit Center) code update request. Updates the PC code / service group mapping for a billing scope. PCCodeUpdate is a non-billable production automation request.

targetServiceGroupName.description: The target service group display name.

serviceSelections.description: The per-service subscription selections for a service-group-scoped PC code update.

serviceTransferIds.description: The per-service transfer IDs generated for a service-group-scoped PC code update.

PCCodeUpdateServiceSelection.description: A service and its selected subscriptions within a service-group-scoped PC code update.

PCCodeUpdateServiceTransfer.description: The transfer ID produced for a single service within a service-group-scoped PC code update.

transferId.description: The transfer ID generated for the service.
